trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep on the distal margins, tapering to sharp points at the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy epibiotic colonization (barnacles) concentrated on the trailing tips and leading edges of the distal lobes.
